## Custom Property Model DL

Custom Property Model DL

Exact job name: `Custom_Property_Model_DL`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `property_name` | string | yes | value | Name of the model or molecular property being predicted (e.g., activity, solubility). |
| `filepath` | string | yes | file | Path to the CSV file containing ligand data with 'SMILES' and 'ACTIVITY' columns. |
| `modeltype` | string | yes | value | Task type for model building. |
| `modelName` | string | yes | value | Exact deep-learning selector emitted by the current product UI. |
| `model_category` | string | yes | value | Exact category selector emitted by the current product UI. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "property_name": {
      "description": "Name of the model or molecular property being predicted (e.g., activity, solubility).",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "filepath": {
      "description": "Path to the CSV file containing ligand data with 'SMILES' and 'ACTIVITY' columns.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "modeltype": {
      "description": "Task type for model building.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "regression",
        "classification"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "modelName": {
      "description": "Exact deep-learning selector emitted by the current product UI.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "DL"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "model_category": {
      "description": "Exact category selector emitted by the current product UI.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "DL"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "property_name",
    "filepath",
    "modeltype",
    "modelName",
    "model_category"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

Custom Property Model ML

## global_ic50

Predict inhibitory potency for compound–protein pairs from direct SMILES and protein-sequence input or a CSV of paired inputs. The product describes pIC50, IC50 in nanomolar units and an activity label; confirm the columns actually returned. Higher pIC50 and lower IC50 indicate greater predicted inhibitory potency, not necessarily binding affinity or experimentally established activity.

[Product description and result interpretation](../boltchem-product-guide.md#ic50)

Exact job name: `global_ic50`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `smiles` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | One ligand SMILES; the live-verified contract is scalar, not batch |
| `sequence` | string | no / mode-dependent | value | One target protein sequence in one-letter notation |
| `filepath` | string | no / mode-dependent | file | Upload a CSV containing paired SMILES and protein sequences; this is an alternative to the scalar smiles + sequence mode. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "smiles": {
      "description": "One ligand SMILES; the live-verified contract is scalar, not batch",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "sequence": {
      "description": "One target protein sequence in one-letter notation",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "filepath": {
      "description": "Upload a CSV containing paired SMILES and protein sequences; this is an alternative to the scalar smiles + sequence mode.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    }
  },
  "required": [],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.

```json
}
```

## Property Prediction (propinf)

Property Prediction (propinf)

Exact job name: `Property_Prediction`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `smiles` | string | yes | file | S3 path to CSV (upload first). A bare SMILES string is **rejected** (`"smiles file must be a uploaded .csv file containing smiles"`); it MUST be an uploaded CSV. All rows are predicted in one call. |
| `global_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Model names as **strings** (not objects, no thresholds). See format + names below. |
| `uncertainty` | number | yes | value | Numeric 0 or 1 in the generated request. |
| `explainability` | number | yes | value | Numeric 0 or 1 in the generated request. |
| `custom_models` | array | no / mode-dependent | value | Selected custom models using the documented object fields below; use authorized model identifiers. |
| `experimentName` | string | no / mode-dependent | value |  |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.
